contexts.text: To leave father and mother () = to [leave] the internal man.
The celestial Angels do not leave him... HH 450.
If man were left to himself, he would rush... AC 868.
Not the least doubt is left.
Man leaves behind nothing except the bones and flesh. HH 461, General article.
That he was left in the proprium. Signified, Explained.
He left his garment ... Explained AC 5028.
In proportion as I was left to my proprium...
To leave () = to be separated. AC 5813.
To leave, here, () = to be there.
To leave the man () = not to be able to be conjoined.
To leave in the field () = to perish by falsities from evils, which are signified by the hail.
The residue... left from the hail () = the truth not consumed by the former falsity. AC 7677.
Not to be left () = not to be wanting.
These truths (are then) left behind...
Ye shall not leave of it until the morning (). Explained.
There was not left in them even to one () = all and each.
To die by the hand of Jehovah = to be left by the Lord; for those who are left by Him rush into evils and the derivative falsities.
When they are left to themselves... AC 9192:6. AC 9399:3. AC 10122:3. HH 395. HH 496. HH 502. LJ 36:2. DLife 44:2. DLW 244. TCR 592. SE 5843:2.
What was left of the flesh and of the bread () = that it was not appropriated. Explained. AC 10115.
He is left in freedom.
They are then left by the Lord; and those who are left by the Lord become as pagans.
The father and mother whom the man shall leave, in the spiritual sense = his proprium of the will and of the understanding...
In temptations, man is apparently left to himself.
In the passion of the cross, the Lord was left to Himself...
He said. The things I have heard I leave.
To leave the first charity () = not to make it the essential of Knowledges.
